messages.author: e1c430550f86b1f6
messages.subject: missing code in exmaple repository reference in the manual?
parts:
Hi all,

Under the Gaussian Process chapter of the STAN reference manual (Ch 14, version: 2.6.2, pg. 140, 142, 143), the footnote mentioned/suggested the code referenced in the text can be found at: http://mc-stan.org/examples.html

I can't find any on that page. Also, I followed the link to the GitHub page and can't seem to find the code referenced in the manual either.

Am I missing something?

Andy

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] missing code in exmaple repository reference in the manual?
parts:
Thank for the heads-up on the manual. I'll fix it in the
next release; here's the issue tracker link:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1420#issuecomment-96373388

The examples are here:

https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/tree/master/misc/gaussian-process

But they're probably not up to date with our best
practices yet. We really need to rework all the
GP material in light of our Cholesky factor types and
my understanding GPs better (or someone who actually
really understands them coding up the examples).

- Bob
